messages:
Priya S.: kicking off preflight for Monsoon Health POC — they asked for SSO + SCIM + RBAC mapping and domain proofing. Can we confirm what we need from their side for an Azure AD SAML setup?
Tom B.: monsoon asked for estimated cost for a 6-week POC (up to 4 concurrent seats) and if we support restricting provisioning to specific groups only. also security questionnaire coming from their compliance team.
Priya S.: OK. high level success criteria: SSO working end-to-end, SCIM provisioning for users+groups (subset), RBAC mapping to 3 roles, and domain ownership verification for their corporate domains. Tom — can you share the questionnaire when you get it?
Tom B.: will drop it here when I get the PDF. asking legal for a copy now.
Raj K.: for SAML: we need their IdP metadata (entityID, SSO URL, x509 cert), and their desired NameID format (email / transient). typical ACS URL: https://redwood.example.com/saml/consume/<customer-id> — we'll provide exact afterward.
Raj K.: SCIM: we support SCIM v2 with the standard endpoints. they asked to provision only users in group "redwood-poc" — we can do group-scoped provisioning. note: incremental provisioning is default, bulk is available if they prefer.
Raj K.: sample SCIM mapping they can use:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "userName": "jane.doe@monsoon.com",
  "name": { "givenName": "Jane", "familyName": "Doe" },
  "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User": { "department": "Product" },
  "groups": [ { "display": "redwood-poc" } ]
}
```
Priya S.: for RBAC we expose role mappings by group or claim. typical mapping we propose: group "redwood-admins" -> admin, "redwood-editors" -> editor, default -> viewer. they want immutable roles for compliance — we can lock mappings per-tenant during the POC.
Tom B.: pricing Q: POC uses hosted API but they asked about Dedicated reserved capacity option and pricing delta for 4 concurrency GPUs — they want a notional monthly number to compare.
Priya S.: for the initial POC we can run on hosted with a small dedicated pool for guaranteed latency — I'll sync with finance for a quick number. Tom, is procurement OK with an NDA for the questionnaire?
Tom B.: yes they already sent an NDA via DocuSign; legal-bot flagged a few items. dropping the questionnaire here when I have it.
legal-bot: FYI: compliance flagged requirement to support KMS-managed keys (tenant-specific) and audit log retention 1 year. we have a Private deployment option that meets both.
Raj K.: SCIM rate limits — recommend they throttle to 10 req/s during onboarding; we can bump during initial sync if needed. also session duration: we support SAML session timeouts and can honor MaxSessionDuration claim.
Priya S.: domain proofing — we'll ask them to add TXT record to DNS for each domain; can do CNAME-based verification as well. provide step-by-step in the POC onboarding doc.
Tom B.: next steps: I will attach the questionnaire + procurement timeline by EOD, Priya will draft POC runbook + success criteria, Raj will prepare SAML metadata & SCIM sample config. sync tomorrow 10am PT? :calendar:
Priya S.: 10am PT works for me. Raj?
Raj K.: works. will attach a sample IdP metadata template and a SCIM test user script to the runbook before the meeting. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: note: staging cluster reserved for "monsoon-poc" on 2026-03-11 14:00 UTC.
Tom B.: thanks all — I'll follow up with attachments.
